reserves.name: Physical gold reserves
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Kinesis Monetary System and Allocated Bullion Exchange

reserveReview.rationale: Kinesis states that KAU represents one gram of fully allocated 9999 gold, with biannual Bureau Veritas physical audits checked against the blockchain record and redemption through Brinks and Loomis. The April 2026 audit page identifies the latest listed gold-and-silver audit, but does not publish a KAU-only quantity split in the reviewed text.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Kinesis allocated-bullion and April 2026 audit disclosures
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The reserve category is fully allocated physical gold, but the reviewed page does not expose current KAU-only bar quantities, vault-level shares, or redemption inventory.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Allocated physical gold is an exogenous commodity reserve rather than a tracked stablecoin dependency. Kinesis discloses LBMA-approved bullion held in ABX/Brink's/Loomis vault networks; the slice name matches the live captured exposure key.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Kinesis describes fully allocated bullion, legal ownership, and vault partners, but the reviewed materials do not establish a statutory bankruptcy-remote vehicle or rehypothecation prohibition.
